title.en: Characteristics, objectives and importance of management

hook.en: You cannot touch management, but you can feel it: a well-run hospital feels calm, a badly run bus stand feels chaotic. Today we list the features that make management what it is.
hook.kn: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸಬಹುದು: ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯದ ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ಗೊಂದಲಮಯವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಂದು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯೋಣ.

objectives.en: List the seven characteristics of management
Classify objectives as organisational, social or personal

narration.en: You cannot touch management, but you can feel it: a well-run hospital feels calm, a badly run bus stand feels chaotic. Today we list the features that make management what it is.
narration.kn: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸಬಹುದು: ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯದ ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ಗೊಂದಲಮಯವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಂದು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯೋಣ.

body.en: Management is goal-oriented, all-pervasive (needed in every type and size of organisation, in every country), multidimensional (management of work, people and operations), a continuous process, a group activity, a dynamic function that adapts to the environment, and an intangible force whose presence is felt in results.

narration.en: Management is goal-oriented, all-pervasive (needed in every type and size of organisation, in every country), multidimensional (management of work, people and operations), a continuous process, a group activity, a dynamic function that adapts to the environment, and an intangible force whose presence is felt in results.
narration.kn: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಗುರಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ, ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ, ಬಹುಆಯಾಮದ, ನಿರಂತರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ, ಗುಂಪು ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ, ಚಲನಶೀಲ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅಮೂರ್ತ ಶಕ್ತಿ.

body.en: Organisational objectives are survival, profit and growth. Social objectives mean creating benefit for society, such as using environment-friendly methods and giving jobs to disadvantaged sections. Personal objectives meet the needs of employees: fair pay, recognition and personal growth.

points.en: Social: environment-friendly methods, employment to the disadvantaged
Personal: pay, recognition, growth of employees

narration.en: Organisational objectives are survival, profit and growth. Social objectives mean creating benefit for society, such as using environment-friendly methods and giving jobs to disadvantaged sections. Personal objectives meet the needs of employees: fair pay, recognition and personal growth.
narration.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ಉಳಿವು, ಲಾಭ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ಸಮಾಜಕ್ಕೆ ಲಾಭ ಮಾಡುವುದು. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು ನೌಕರರ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸುವುದು.

body.en: Management helps in achieving group goals, increases efficiency, creates a dynamic organisation that can adapt to change, helps achieve the personal objectives of employees, and helps in the development of society through better products, jobs and new technology.

narration.en: Management helps in achieving group goals, increases efficiency, creates a dynamic organisation that can adapt to change, helps achieve the personal objectives of employees, and helps in the development of society through better products, jobs and new technology.
narration.kn: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಗುಂಪಿನ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆ, ದಕ್ಷತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Take the first letter of each sentence word: Goal-oriented, All-pervasive, Multidimensional, Continuous, Group activity, Dynamic, Intangible.

mnemonic.en: Good Actors Make Characters Grow Daily, Invisibly

problem.en: Sunrise Foods, a snack maker in Mysuru, has switched to paper packaging and has hired 40 women from nearby villages. Which objective of management is it fulfilling?

steps.en: Paper packaging protects the environment: a benefit to society.
Jobs for women from villages give employment to a disadvantaged section.
Both actions are for the good of society, not mainly for profit or for existing employees.
